subject: general
question: Which of the following properties is NOT shown by bleaching powder?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reducing agent.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Bleaching powder **has a **distinct chlorine odor **and is a **light yellowish** **powder**.
 
• Although it is **soluble **in **water**, there are always **impurities present**, therefore a clear solution is never seen.
 
• Its scientific name is **Calcium hypochlorite**, and its chemical formula is **Ca(OCl₂).**
 
• It is employed in the **textile sector **as a bleaching agent for **cotton **and **linen **as well as for the laundry's use in bleaching soiled clothing.
 
• Due to its potent **oxidizing properties**, it is employed as an **oxidizer **in numerous industries.
 
• Bleaching powder **cannot **be **used **as a **reducing agent **because it is an oxidizing agent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• A chemical species known as a reducing agent in chemistry is one that "**donates**" an electron to an **electron** **recipient **(also known as a reductant, reducer, or electron donor).
 
• Earth metals, formic **acid**, **oxalic acid**, and **sulfite compounds **are a few examples of chemicals that are frequently used as reducing agents.
 
• In their pre-reaction states, **oxidizers lack** **electrons **while reducers do (that is, they are by themselves oxidized).
 
• Their **oxidation states **are a typical way to communicate this.
